g.text: L3 Deployment View - As-Is . Click here to see the To-Be

g.title:
Cloudflare WAF
Features: - DDoS protection - Bot management - Rate limiting - SSL/TLS termination - Geo-routing
Global CDN: - Static assets - API response caching - Image optimization

g.text: ⚠️ GDPR: Customer PII remains in EU region

g.title:
External System
Location: US-based SaaS Connectivity: Public internet (HTTPS) Data: Product catalog, orders
Latency: - US East: ~50ms - West EU: ~120ms - SE Asia: ~200ms

External System
Location: Multi-region SaaS Connectivity: Public internet (HTTPS) Data: Customer loyalty points
Regional endpoints: - US: us.loyalty.com - EU: eu.loyalty.com - APAC: apac.loyalty.com

External System (TO-BE)
Location: US-based SaaS Connectivity: Public internet (HTTPS) Data: Customer master data
Data Sync: - Direction: One-way (Azure → CRM) - Frequency: Real-time (event-driven) - PII Handling: Encrypted in transit

g.text: • Customer PII stays in origin region

g.title:
Azure API Management
AZ: East US - Zone 1 SKU: Premium (99.99% SLA)
Features: - API throttling - Request/response transformation - OAuth 2.0 validation - Request logging

Azure App Service
AZ: East US - Zone 1 SKU: P3V3 (Zone redundant) Runtime: .NET 8 Instances: Auto-scale 2-10
Data Access: - Redis Cache (local AZ) - Azure SQL (zone-redundant) - Blob Storage (LRS)

Azure API Management
AZ: East US - Zone 2 SKU: Premium (Zone redundant)
Role: Active-Active with AZ1

Azure App Service
AZ: East US - Zone 2 SKU: P3V3 (Zone redundant) Runtime: .NET 8 Instances: Auto-scale 2-10

Azure SQL Database
Tier: Business Critical (Zone-redundant) Replicas: 3 (across AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
Data Classification: - PII: Customer accounts - Transactional: Orders, cart
Residency: US East only Backup: GRS (paired to West US 2)

Azure Redis Cache
Tier: Premium (Zone-redundant) Replicas: 2 (AZ1, AZ2)
Use Cases: - Session state - API response cache (60s TTL) - Rate limiting counters
Residency: US East only

Azure Blob Storage
Redundancy: LRS (Locally redundant)
Data: - Product images - User uploads - Architecture diagrams
Residency: US East only No cross-border replication

Azure API Management
AZ: West Europe - Zone 1 SKU: Premium (Zone redundant)

Azure App Service
AZ: West Europe - Zone 1 SKU: P3V3 (Zone redundant) Runtime: .NET 8 Instances: Auto-scale 2-10
GDPR Compliance: - PII data processing in EU only - Data subject access requests - Right to be forgotten implementation

Azure SQL Database
Tier: Business Critical (Zone-redundant) Replicas: 3 (across AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
GDPR Data: - Customer PII (EU residents) - GDPR audit logs
Residency: West Europe only Backup: GRS (paired to North Europe)
⚠️ NO cross-border replication to US/APAC

Azure Redis Cache
Tier: Premium (Zone-redundant) Replicas: 2 (AZ1, AZ2)
Residency: West Europe only

Azure Blob Storage
Redundancy: LRS Residency: West Europe only
⚠️ GDPR: No replication outside EU

Azure API Management
AZ: Southeast Asia - Zone 1 SKU: Premium (Zone redundant)

Azure App Service

Compliance: - PDPA (Singapore) - Privacy Act (Australia) - Data localization requirements

Azure SQL Database
Tier: Business Critical (Zone-redundant) Replicas: 3 (across AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)

Residency: Southeast Asia only Backup: GRS (paired to East Asia)
⚠️ Data localization per country requirements

Azure Redis Cache

Residency: Southeast Asia only

Azure Blob Storage
